name: drupal-local-env
description: Use when setting up, running or troubleshooting the local development environment of a Drupal project, either DDEV (.ddev/config.yaml, ddev start / drush / composer, snapshots, add-ons, Mutagen, Xdebug, ddev share, ddev pull) or a plain Docker Compose stack (compose.yaml / docker-compose.yml with PHP-FPM, nginx, MariaDB/MySQL, Redis).

interface.longDescription: Use when setting up, running or troubleshooting the local development environment of a Drupal project, either DDEV (.ddev/config.yaml, ddev start / drush / composer, snapshots, add-ons, Mutagen, Xdebug, ddev share, ddev pull) or a plain Docker Compose stack (compose.yaml / docker-compose.yml with PHP-FPM, nginx, MariaDB/MySQL, Redis). Use when you must first detect which of the two a project uses, when importing or exporting a local database, onboarding an existing project, adding Redis/Solr locally, or fixing port conflicts, file permissions, slow file sync and containers that will not start. Not for production deploy, tests or security (drupal11-devops-testing-security) nor config sync (drupal11-config-management).
